CONCAT(#{item.emailId},'')

SELECT SUM(TOT_CNT) AS TOT_CNT ,SUM(SUCC_CNT) AS SUCC_CNT ,SUM(FAIL_CNT) AS FAIL_CNT FROM EMS_REPORT WHERE MEMO = CONCAT(#{emailId},'')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EMS_REPORT_DETAIL WHERE MSG_ID IN ( SELECT MSG_ID FROM EMS_REPORT WHERE MEMO = CONCAT(#{emailId},'') )

SELECT RCV_NM AS USER_NAME ,RCV_MAIL AS EMAIL ,RESULT_CD AS RESULT_CODE ,PROCESSED_DATE FROM EMS_REPORT_DETAIL WHERE MSG_ID IN ( SELECT MSG_ID FROM EMS_REPORT WHERE MEMO = CONCAT(#{emailId},'') ) ORDER BY SUB_ID DESC LIMIT (#{pagination.currentPage} -1) * #{pagination.itemsPerPage}, #{pagination.itemsPerPage}
